scientific_constraints_and_blockers.rationale: The authentic benchmark dataset contains exactly 0 successful hijackings and 0 harmful action proposals across all 35 trajectories (25 attacked, 10 benign) and 119 gate points. Evaluating a binary classifier on an all-negative ground truth yields undefined TPR and deceptive ROC-AUC.
scientific_constraints_and_blockers.trajectory_independence_warning: The 119 gate points originate from 35 trajectories and are clustered within conversations (e.g., user_task_6 emitted up to 34 gate points in a single run). Gate points from the same trajectory cannot be treated as independent experimental samples.
scientific_constraints_and_blockers.fpr_calibration_limitation: Only 10 benign trajectories exist. While suitable for initial exploratory false-alarm observations, statistically rigorous per-trajectory FPR bounds (e.g., FPR <= 5%) require larger benign sample sizes.

recommended_next_milestone: Phase 4B completed: 25 provenance and structural features extracted for all 76 gate points with causal isolation. Exploratory negative-only evaluation completed on 7 benign trajectories. Positive-class sensitivity/TPR evaluation remains blocked until authentic positive hijackings can be acquired without synthetic data.
